'''Interpreter's Retreat''' was settlement of the planet [[Voss]] which was a sacred place for [[Interpreter (Voss)|interpreters]] to work. It was located near the shrines of [[Shrine of Judgment|Judgment]], [[Shrine of Contemplation|Contemplation]] and [[Shrine of Silence|Silence]]. Most of the Retreat was forbidden for outsiders to visit without special permission.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Voss]]}}</ref>
